_meta.kind: TEMPLATE — founder gates, frozen before V1 measurement
_meta.fill_rule: Every field whose value is null or "PENDING" is a TODO marker. Write measured values in place, set status to PASS/FAIL, and record the producing experiment + artifact path. The package ships only when every gate in 'gates' is PASS.
protocol_refs: docs/benchmarks/NATURALNESS-GATE.md (GATE-NAT-01, frozen 2026-08-22, anchors measured on this machine)

naturalness.command: benchmarks/run_natgate.py generate --engine caedral-v1 && scripts/classify_preview.py ... && benchmarks/run_natgate.py compare

voices_approved.requirement: >= min_voices_approved of 15 catalog voices pass the human listening gate
voices_approved.producing_experiment: human listening gate over CV-G1-E0013 final model renders (slate: docs/data/VOICE-SLATE-V1.md)

longform_variance.threshold: <= longform_variance_max (population variance of per-chunk dual-ASR minWER over long_001)
longform_variance.producing_experiment: CV-G1-E0014 protocol re-run on V1 model

reference_anchor_fail.note: diagnostic prototype, recorded for honesty — V1 must beat this

intelligibility.requirement: WER median comparable to anchors at corpus defaults (anchors: Kokoro WER med 0.00 / max 0.33 = known acr_005 hyphen artifact; Piper med 0.00)
intelligibility.producing_experiment: natgate scoring stage (dual-ASR minWER, faster-whisper small.en + base.en int8)

speaker_similarity.requirement: per-voice ECAPA-TDNN cosine gen-vs-reference with anchor delta; drift flag if delta < -0.08 (EVALUATION-BENCHMARKS G4)
speaker_similarity.producing_experiment: V1 eval extension of natgate harness (ECAPA-TDNN, Apache-2.0)

performance_profiles.requirement: RTF < 1.0 single-thread viable; RAM within deployment profile caps (A <=4GB / B <=2GB / C <=1GB); TTFA reported at threads {1,2,4,default}; CPU-only box
performance_profiles.producing_experiment: thread sweep on V1 (fresh-process runs per OMP_NUM_THREADS)

provenance_constraints.meaning: No artifact classes outside the allow-list may enter the shipped package. Concretely prohibited today: jik876 HiFi-GAN original checkpoints (NO STATED LICENSE), Piper-derived training data (GPL gray, TEACHER-DATA-ENGINE Path B EXCLUDED), any CC-BY-NC weights (Emilia/F5-TTS class). Teacher audio (Kokoro) is training-data-only and never ships.
provenance_constraints.honesty_charter: Every number labeled MEASURED / REPORTED BY THIRD PARTY / ESTIMATED / HYPOTHESIS; failed targets publish the measured minimum instead.
